name: La Maldición Winchester
source:
Haunted by tragedy, she builds a mansion to keep the darkness out. But the daughter-in-law of the Winchester rifle inventor soon learns some horrors cannot be contained.

[From [url=https://fernigt801.itch.io/winchesters-tale]Itch.io[/url]]
translation:
悲剧困扰着她，她建造了一座豪宅来抵御黑暗。但温彻斯特步枪发明者的儿媳很快就发现有些恐怖无法遏制。

[来自[url=https://fernigt801.itch.io/winchesters-tale]Itch.io[/url]]
